before.zh: 记录当时可选的休息活动与实际选择。
before.en: Record available ways to rest and the activity chosen.

after.zh: 记录附近休闲设施的开放时间和使用情况。
after.en: Record opening hours and use of nearby leisure facilities.

before.zh: 查阅健康资料，拟定桌面活动的休息提示。
before.en: Use health information to prepare rest-break guidance.

after.zh: 根据健康资料，整理活动中的休息提示。
after.en: Use health information to prepare rest-break guidance.

before.zh: 核对活动中的饮水和身体不适提醒所依据的资料。
before.en: Check sources for hydration and physical-discomfort guidance.

after.zh: 核对饮水与身体不适提醒的资料。
after.en: Check sources for hydration and physical-discomfort guidance.

before.zh: 核对视频中的疲惫和休息提示所引的健康资料。
before.en: Check health sources behind guidance on tiredness and rest.

after.zh: 核对疲惫与休息提示的健康资料。
after.en: Check health sources behind guidance on tiredness and rest.

before.zh: 核对手部卫生与食物接触提示的健康依据。
before.en: Check health guidance on hand hygiene and food contact.

after.zh: 根据资料，整理进餐前的手卫生提示。
after.en: Use supplied guidance to prepare hand-hygiene reminders before eating.

before.zh: 根据样件和图纸检查零件尺寸与装配位置。
before.en: Check component dimensions and assembly positions against samples and drawings.

after.zh: 根据图纸检查零件尺寸与装配位置。
after.en: Check part sizes and assembly positions using drawings.

before.zh: 检查哪些居民被纳入调查，哪些人可能被遗漏。
before.en: Check which residents were surveyed and who may have been missed.

after.zh: 核对调查覆盖和遗漏的居民群体。
after.en: Check which resident groups the survey includes or misses.

before.zh: 设置预约系统与设备使用记录的权限。
before.en: Set up booking-system permissions and device-use records.

after.zh: 设置预约时段冲突的自动检查。
after.en: Set up automatic checks for conflicting booking times.

before.zh: 整理设备使用中涉及的材料来源与生态影响资料。
before.en: Gather information on material origins and ecological impacts of device use.

after.zh: 整理工具使用对土壤和植物的影响。
after.en: Summarise how tool use affects soil and plants.
